_readme: Edit THIS file, then run Build-Site.ps1 . Every build regenerates all pages from the pristine _source folder, so it is always safe to re-run.

brand.name: Minted Dental
brand.description: Minted Dental is a modern dental clinic offering gentle, expert care - from preventive checkups and cosmetic dentistry to restorative treatments and orthodontics. Book your visit today.
brand._siteUrlNote: Your live URL, no trailing slash. Open Graph requires ABSOLUTE image URLs - with a relative path, Facebook/LinkedIn/WhatsApp/X render the link preview with no image at all. Leave blank until you know the domain; the build will warn.

contact._note: phoneDisplay is the readable text on the page. phoneTel is what every tel: link dials. This is the Desert Ridge line. Scottsdale's (480) 697-4997 is set per-location on the about page location cards.

clinics.name: Scottsdale
clinics.address: 8776 E Shea Blvd Ste 107, Scottsdale, AZ 85260

booking._note: Booking runs through Flexbook. Set url to a tel: link instead if you want the CTAs to dial the clinic.

careers._note: Where the 'Apply Now' buttons on about.html go. Deliberately separate from booking so job applicants do not land on appointment scheduling.

social._note: Real profiles from minteddental.com. Set a value to "" to strip that network's icons entirely rather than link to a bare homepage. Minted Dental has no public X/Twitter account, so twitter is empty.

assets._note: generateLogo:true draws a wordmark from brand.shortName. Set false to use your own files below. logoStyle 'badge' sizes a square/circular logo correctly in the nav and footer; use 'wordmark' for a wide horizontal logo.

theme._note: primary is the main accent. dark is the deep background/footer. accent is used for highlighted words on dark sections.

themeVariantBlue._note: Optional second palette used only by the variant-blue/ copy. Delete this whole block to make variant-blue inherit the main theme.

text._note: Replace any on-page copy. Left side = the exact text currently in the site, right side = your text.
text.Trusted Dental Care for Every Generation: Trusted Dental Care for Every Generation
